guidelines.title: header search placeholder visible search control
guidelines.rule: Header search may use placeholder + visible Search control — the only named placeholder-as-visible-label exception: visually hidden `<label>`, placeholder “Zoek”, submit with text and/or magnifying-glass. Does not pass on ordinary fields. Dual-cite Forms no-placeholder-as-label. Placeholder/label lock unchanged.
pass_when: Header search: hidden `<label>` + placeholder “Zoek” + visible Search control. Ordinary fields still have a visible label (lock).
fail_when: An ordinary field uses placeholder as its only label, citing this exception; or header search has no visible Search control and no accessible name.
guidelines.do_not_claim: Placeholder-as-label as passing on non-search fields; GOLD search attributes as this exception.

guidelines.title: no forced input patterns or masks
guidelines.rule: No forced input patterns / masks — `pattern` + JS that blocks non-matching keystrokes fails foreign phone numbers, “call afternoons only”, and letter names. Password-style exact format is the exception and must be in the description, not a vanishing placeholder. Dual-cite Spectrum format-valid icon (format-match, not a mask); do not collapse. `inputmode="numeric"` is fine.
pass_when: No HTML `pattern` and no mask that strips keys or jumps the caret on flexible fields; format lives in a description; `inputmode="numeric"` may be present. Password exact-match (described) is the named exception.
fail_when: HTML `pattern` and/or JS that strips keys or jumps the caret.
guidelines.do_not_claim: Spectrum format-valid icon as this ban; placeholder as the format instruction (placeholder lock); `inputmode="numeric"` as a fail; don’t-reject-variants as this row.

guidelines.title: dont reject valid variants
guidelines.rule: Don’t reject valid variants — accept `+` addressing in email (`naam+werk@…`); postcodes with/without space and case; trim pasted leading/trailing spaces. Normalise in software instead of erroring the person.

citation.source: NL Design System — Keur niet te snel af

pass_when: Email accepts `+` in the local-part; postcode variants with/without space and mixed case are accepted and normalised; pasted spaces are trimmed.
fail_when: `naam+werk@…` is rejected; `1234 AA` vs `1234AA` vs case/spaces is rejected instead of normalised.
guidelines.do_not_claim: HTML `pattern`/mask ban as this row; format-upfront copy as this row.

guidelines.title: no min max length names places
guidelines.rule: No min/max length on names and places — one-character given names and 50-character place names exist. Dual-cite USWDS “raise the DB limit” / character-count not as a cap.

citation.source: NL Design System — Geen min/max lengte

pass_when: Unconstrained name and place fields have no rejecting `minLength`/`maxLength`.
fail_when: `minLength`/`maxLength` rejects a one-character name or a long toponym.
guidelines.do_not_claim: Character-count component; USWDS raise-the-cap as a merge.

guidelines.title: no select multiple
guidelines.rule: Don’t use `<select multiple>` — keyboard/VoiceOver (Safari) cannot operate it. Use checkboxes for multi-pick.

citation.source: NL Design System — Iedereen kan invullen

pass_when: Multi-choice uses checkboxes, not native `<select multiple>`.
guidelines.do_not_claim: GOLD avoid-select-except-long-lists as this multi-select ban; NSW multi-select pattern as a winner.

guidelines.title: step n of m in title and above form
guidelines.rule: Step n of m in `document.title` and above the form — e.g. `Stap 2 van 6`. Prefer text over a progress bar (scales under zoom). If a SPA swaps steps on one URL, still update the title. Dual-cite GOV.UK “test without a progress indicator”; this names the title + heading pair and SPA title rewrite. Conditional step counts: NL says evidence is insufficient — do not invent a house rule.
pass_when: `document.title` and the heading above the form both include step n of m (text, not only a bar); SPA step swaps update the title.
fail_when: Step n of m is missing from the title or from above the form; SPA keeps a stale title; a house rule for conditional step counts is invented.
guidelines.do_not_claim: GOLD out-of-order progress indicator; GOV.UK test-without as a merge that drops title+heading; a house conditional-count rule.

guidelines.title: last step is send not volgende
guidelines.rule: Last step is not “Volgende” — final submit names send (`Versturen` / outcome). Show a check-page of answers with edit before that. Dual-cite GOV.UK check-answers; this names the label change on the last step.
pass_when: Last-step button names send/outcome, not “Volgende”; answers are shown with edit before send.
fail_when: Last step still says “Volgende” / “Next”, or there is no check-page with edit.
guidelines.do_not_claim: GOV.UK check-answers as a merge that drops the last-step label change; GOLD Next-primary/Save-secondary; “Volgende stap”/“Vorige stap” as a second Actions clone (kept in this row).

guidelines.title: labels contain only text
guidelines.rule: Labels contain only text — no links, buttons, tooltips, or headings inside `<label>`. Voice control and screen readers break. Dual-cite clickable-label (Vercel) without stuffing interactive children into the label.

citation.source: NL Design System — Labels alleen tekst

pass_when: `<label>` contains text only — no nested link, button, tooltip, or heading.
fail_when: Interactive or heading content is nested inside `<label>`.
guidelines.do_not_claim: Privacy-link-outside-label as a duplicate of this general ban; visible-label lock as this row.

guidelines.title: privacy terms link outside label
guidelines.rule: Privacy / terms link sits outside the label — not “I agree to the [privacy policy]” as a nested `<a>`. Put the link above, or in a fieldset description via `aria-describedby`.

citation.source: NL Design System — Niet in label

pass_when: Policy/terms link is above the control or in a fieldset description (`aria-describedby`), not nested in the `<label>`.
fail_when: A privacy/terms `<a>` is nested inside the agreement `<label>`.
guidelines.do_not_claim: Labels-contain-only-text as this privacy-pattern row; contact pages.

guidelines.title: form draft links new tab named in link
guidelines.rule: In-form links that must not lose the draft open in a new tab, and say so in the link text — `target="_blank"` plus visible “(opent in een nieuwe tab)” (or icon + equivalent SR text inside the link). Dual-cite USWDS identify-destination; this is draft-preservation + in-link announcement.
pass_when: Draft-preserving form links use `target="_blank"` and name the new tab in the link’s visible/SR text.
fail_when: A form link opens a new tab with no in-link announcement, or a same-tab link drops the draft with no new-tab path when the source required it.
guidelines.do_not_claim: USWDS identify-destination as a merge that drops draft-preservation; labels-only-text as this row.

guidelines.title: success confirms what not bounce home
guidelines.rule: Success is not “form sent” or a bounce to home — visible confirmation of what went through (repeat in mail or “Mijn omgeving”). Dual-cite empty/failure success copy; NL names bounce-home as fail.
pass_when: After send, the person sees what was submitted (on-page and/or in mail / “Mijn omgeving”), not only “sent”.
fail_when: Success is only “form sent”, or the person is bounced to home with no confirmation of what went through.
guidelines.do_not_claim: Next organisational steps as this “what went through” row; empty/failure success-copy as a merge that drops bounce-home.

guidelines.title: name next organisational steps
guidelines.rule: Name the next organisational steps — e.g. case number, who acts, how the person hears back. (Contact-channel pages not filed.)
pass_when: Confirmation names what happens next: case number and/or who acts and/or how the person hears back.
fail_when: Confirmation has no next organisational step (no case number, actor, or how they hear back).
guidelines.do_not_claim: Contact-channel pages; success-what-went-through as this next-steps row.

guidelines.title: dont auto dismiss status announce complete
guidelines.rule: Don’t auto-dismiss status; if the message is time-bound, announce completion — “uploading…” may vanish when done and a live region must say “upload complete.” Dual-cite Spectrum toast ≥5s / Suomi 10s; no house seconds.
pass_when: Status that is still relevant stays; time-bound status that vanishes is replaced by a live-region completion announcement.
fail_when: Status auto-dismisses with no completion announcement.
guidelines.do_not_claim: A house toast duration; Suomi toast geometry as this live-region row.

guidelines.title: mark optional niet verplicht above form
guidelines.rule: Mark the exception: `(niet verplicht)` not “optioneel” — NL research prefers marking optional fields because most asked fields should be required. Instruction above the form. Dual-cite NN/g mark-optional / Fluent all-required-one-instruction / Spectrum never-mark-optional / Suomi parenthetical optional; do not pick a house winner. Unique claims: Dutch wording and above-form key.
pass_when: One cited school applied consistently: NL `(niet verplicht)` + above-form key; or Suomi default-required + parenthetical optional; or mark-the-minority; or mark-both. On an NL-school form, optional is `(niet verplicht)` not “optioneel”, with the key above the form.
fail_when: Optional vs required unmarked; schools mixed on one form; a house asterisk invented; NL-school form uses “optioneel” or puts the key only in a tooltip.
guidelines.do_not_claim: A house required marker; Suomi parenthetical optional as this Dutch-wording/above-form row.

guidelines.title: long legal jargon before form not tooltip
guidelines.rule: Long or legal jargon lives before the form, not in tooltips — extra click/keystroke hides important copy; screen readers miss loose blocks between questions. Dual-cite Spectrum tooltip last-resort.
pass_when: Long/legal help is before the form (or on an intro page), not only in a tooltip or loose between questions.
fail_when: Important long/legal copy is only in a tooltip or only as a loose block between questions.
guidelines.do_not_claim: Spectrum tooltip-last-resort as a merge; format-in-description from the `pattern` ban as this length/placement row.

guidelines.title: native required bubbles not error ui
guidelines.rule: Native HTML `required` / browser bubbles are not the error UI — insufficient explanation, especially with `pattern`. Prefer custom client errors; `novalidate` once JS loads if `required` was a no-JS fallback. Server-side validation is the guideline. Dual-cite GOLD server-side + error list (not a separate GOLD unique in this 40).
pass_when: With JS, native bubbles are not the error UI (`novalidate` if `required` is a no-JS fallback); errors are custom; server-side validation remains.
fail_when: Browser `required`/`pattern` bubbles are the only error UI after JS has loaded.
guidelines.do_not_claim: GOV.UK error-summary as this native-bubble ban; an invented GOLD “server-side” unique; WCAG numbers.
